description: Conversational bulk-add for opening boosters: adds cards with origin preset to "booster" and location defaulting to "Unsorted". Give one item per distinct card (name [+ set_code, collector_number] or scryfall_id) with quantity and optional finish (foil pulls!). Unresolvable names come back under "unresolved" — ask the user to clarify those. The pack is added in one write, and a name added as Scryfall's closest match or read in another language is listed under "inexact" with the card it became: tell the user.

name.description: Card name in English or any language Scryfall prints ("Blitzschlag", "Foudre", "稲妻"), used when scryfall_id is absent; an English name is also fuzzy-resolved via Scryfall

scryfall_id.description: Exact Scryfall printing id, if known

set_code.description: Set the pack is from — applied to every item without its own set_code
